description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about missed connections.

files.description: A Slack thread in #refunds-desk between Skyway staff about missed connections, dated between 2026-07-06 and 2026-08-18: a normal working conversation; one message may carry each sentence below. It must contain these sentences word for word: "a connection missed for weather or air traffic control follows the normal change rules". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not end the thread with a summary of the answer. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
